view.scene_description: A modern, well-lit interior space resembling a bookstore or lounge with extensive bookshelves, seating areas, and a reflective ceiling. People are seated at tables or standing near shelves. The design features warm wood tones, orange chairs, and blue-tinted glass walls. Lighting is bright and layered, creating an inviting atmosphere.

objects.label: bookshelf
objects.observation: Tall wooden bookshelf filled with books, extending from floor to ceiling on the left wall. Books are arranged neatly in rows. Illuminated by recessed lighting above. Partially obscured by people sitting nearby.

objects.label: ceiling
objects.observation: High ceiling with recessed lights and reflective panels. Reflective surfaces mirror the bookshelves below. Dark structural beams are visible. Ceiling extends across entire frame, above seating area.

objects.label: orange chair
objects.observation: Orange upholstered chair with metal base. Located in foreground and midground, facing tables. Some chairs are occupied by people. Chairs are arranged around round tables.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: Person wearing light green jacket and jeans, seated in orange chair. Facing away from camera. Appears to be reading or using device. Seated at table with other people nearby.

objects.label: table
objects.observation: Round, dark-colored table with metal legs. Located in foreground and midground. Supported by metal base. Occupied by people sitting in orange chairs.

objects.label: glass wall
objects.observation: Large blue-tinted glass wall on right side of frame. Reflects interior lighting and structures. Provides view into adjacent space. Glass panels are framed with metallic trim.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000017", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
